paymentClassification.policy: Standalone cash payments remain in Bank, Financial Ledger and Cash Flow exactly once. Only reviewed operating expenses reduce management P&L on payment date. adjustments.policy: Credit notes reduce proportional net sales and invoice VAT on the note date. Bad debt is a separate non-cash loss on the audited write-off date; it does not grant automatic VAT relief. Linked debt recoveries/reversals are separate other income on their bank-record date, not new invoice sales or VAT. This is a management-report convention, not a tax-filing certification.
